images.note: Real, widely-used diagram from Red Hat's own 'What is CI/CD?' explainer, showing the three stages — Continuous Integration (build, test, merge), Continuous Delivery (automatically release to a repository), Continuous Deployment (automatically deploy to production) — as one flow.

imageNote: Found via a Browser check of redhat.com's rendered img.src values. Searched several vendor-neutral sources first (Atlassian, GitLab, GeeksforGeeks) but none had a real diagram for this concept specifically — Red Hat's is the standard, widely-referenced illustration of the CI vs. CD vs. CD distinction.
